_comment: Canonical dataset specification for all norm-free Mamba-3 ablation runs. Fields are frozen before any 350M experiment starts. Changing these fields invalidates comparisons.
shard_format: pre-tokenized .bin shards, stored on local NVMe

notes.why_20B: 60x Chinchilla-optimal at 350M. Deliberate overtraining to expose stability differences between BCNorm and element-wise replacements.
notes.why_seed_fixed: Reproducibility across variants. Never regenerate shards — use seed-fixed copy.
notes.why_gpt2_tokenizer: Matches Mamba-3 paper evaluation setup for HellaSwag/ARC/WinoGrande/PIQA zero-shot benchmarks.
notes.why_seqlen_2048: Standard LM context length. chunk_size=64 divides 2048 evenly (32 chunks).
